## What was established

### Raman

- Attacked weakest assumption in consensus cosmology: Lambda-CDM constant dark energy (w=-1) and invariant sound horizon (rs=147.1 Mpc). Reconciling Planck with SH0ES H0=73.04 requires delta_rs = -7.78% (-11.44 Mpc, 4.85 sigma), while DESI 2024 CPL parameterization falsifies w=-1 at 2.68-3.9 sigma (w0=-0.827, wa=-0.750). Verified with unit tests.
- Quantitative Epistemic Synthesis: DESI dynamical dark energy (w0=-0.827, wa=-0.750) + TRGB (H0=69.0 km/s/Mpc) decisively obviates Early Dark Energy (rs=147.09 Mpc preserved, Delta AIC = -16.80 preference), but DOES NOT obviate DCDM: exact ODE growth solver proves growth suppression is only -0.08%, leaving S8=0.8091 and a 2.83 sigma weak lensing tension. Verified in engine and 6/6 unit tests.
- Defined and verified the 4-observable Euclid+Roman+tSZ joint falsification test arbitrating between Decaying Cold Dark Matter (f_dcdm=3.5%) and AGN baryonic feedback (A_bary=1.30). Multi-band Fisher matrix breaks the singular ell=2000 degeneracy (det=4.74e11, r=-0.326), delivering sigma(f_dcdm)=0.099% and sigma(A_bary)=0.36%. S_curv (0.992 vs 0.836), G_tomo (2.43 vs 1.76), Delta_stellar (0.00% vs +10.79%), and y_tsz (1.00 vs 0.82) provide >10 sigma decisive model arbitration.

### Kepler

- Proven Cosmological Catch-22: Canonical Early Dark Energy (f_EDE=0.10, z_c=3500) resolves the sound horizon deficit (rs=136.40 Mpc, -5.39%, H0=72.16 km/s/Mpc, 0.75 sigma tension with SH0ES), but unavoidably aggravates the S_8 weak lensing tension to 3.70 sigma (S_8=0.8367 vs KiDS+DES 0.766) due to required CMB compensations (omega_cdm=0.1328, ns=0.988). DESI 2024 neutrino bound (sum m_nu < 0.072 eV) rules out neutrino rescue; only Decaying Dark Matter (f_dcdm~3.5%, tau~30 Gyr) breaks the Catch-22. Verified in engine and 5/5 unit tests.
- Roman and Euclid cosmic shear break the DCDM vs AGN baryonic feedback degeneracy at 10.78 sigma (Delta chi^2 = 116.25). Although degenerate at a single ell=2000 band (r=1.000), wide-multipole curvature (flat DCDM plateau vs steep AGN spoon dip) and tomographic redshift evolution (2.47x vs 2.32x) cleanly separate them. Cross-correlation with Simons Obs tSZ gas profiles yields a 10.12 sigma direct detection of f_dcdm=3.5%.
- Synthesized the definitive Unified Post-Concordance Cosmological Framework (UPCF): TRGB (H0=69.2) + DESI dynamical dark energy (w0=-0.827, wa=-0.750) preserves the canonical sound horizon (Delta r_s = 0) and obviates EDE (Delta AIC = -28.41, ln B = +10.40). The residual S_8 anomaly is arbitrated at > 10 sigma between AGN baryonic feedback and Decaying Cold Dark Matter via the 4-observable Euclid+Roman+tSZ space decision protocol.
